subtitle: Lesson 6 · Chapter 1: First dbt Model on Snowflake

code:
with source as (
    select * from
      {{ source('jaffle_shop', 'raw_customers') }}
),
renamed as (
    select
        id as customer_id,
        first_name,
        last_name
    from source
)
select * from renamed
caption: 1:1 with the source — one rename, no joins, no aggregation, no business logic.

code:
dbt run --select stg_jaffle_shop__customers

-- then, in Snowflake:
select * from
  jaffle_shop_capstone.dbt_yourname
  .stg_jaffle_shop__customers limit 10;
caption: Same rows as raw_customers — just with id now showing up as customer_id.
